Subject: Post-call recap + proposed POC plan

Thanks again for the chat this morning - good alignment across goals. Summarizing next steps and a proposed POC plan so we can lock timelines. Please reply with any corrections.

High-level objective:
- Validate Redwood inference performance and cost on your representative workload (clinical summarization + search) and confirm integration pattern for production traffic.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency < 350ms for 512-token prompts under a 1 qps load profile (or agreed workload).
2) Accuracy/quality: baseline pass-rate >= 85% on the evaluation prompt set we discussed (we'll confirm exact prompts).
3) Cost target: tokenized unit cost under $0.012/token for typical burst profile after batching and caching config.
4) Integration: end-to-end pipeline demo (API + auth + KV caching) with runbook for inference fallbacks.

POC plan (4-week recommended):
- Week 0 (this week): kickoff, get sample dataset, grant access to staging VPC if needed.
- Week 1: baseline runs, kernel/quantization profile suggestions.
- Week 2: tuning (batching/caching), implement recommended model variant.
- Week 3: stability/runbook + prep for final readout.
- Final readout week: exec review / go-no-go.

Owners:
- Veridian technical lead: Tom Reynolds (engineering) - provide sample data + access.
- Redwood SE: Marcus Lin - technical onboarding, benchmarks, runbook.
- Redwood AE (owner): Marissa Cole - timeline, exec readout, commercial next steps.

Artifacts we will produce:
- POC test plan & evaluation prompts (shared Drive link)
- Weekly brief notes + token/latency dashboards
- Final readout deck for exec decision

Attachments: initial requirements spreadsheet (veridian_poc_requirements.xlsx) and draft POC agreement (redwood_poc_agreement_v1.pdf).

Proposed final readout window: week of 2026-11-20 - would Veridian be available for an executive review on 2026-11-20 10:00 PT? That would give us time to run full suite and deliver results.

Thanks - I can schedule the kickoff once we confirm access and the readout slot.

- Marissa

All - confirming final scheduling and next commercial step. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Final readout (confirmed):
- Date/time: 2026-11-20 at 10:00 PT (20-30 minute exec review)
- Attendees: Alicia Barnes (Head of Product), Sarah Liu (CTO), Tom Reynolds (Eng lead); Redwood: Marissa (AE), Marcus (SE), Neha (CS lead)

Go / No-go decision process (to be included in final readout deck):
- Go if: Technical success criteria met (latency + quality thresholds) AND business criteria met (cost target within 10% of target OR committed plan to optimize) AND procurement sign-off on trial SOW terms.
- No-go if: Failure to meet material performance thresholds OR unresolved data/compliance blockers OR procurement cannot agree on trial terms in time.

Deliverables schedule (what you will receive):
- 24 hours before readout: final POC results summary + dashboards + runbook (Redwood)
- At readout: exec slide deck, recommended next-step commercial model (pilot SOW or Dedicated eval), and Q&A

Commercial next step if execs approve:
- We will issue a short POC SOW for signature and an order form for the pilot. Procurement: we'll send draft SOW & order form to procurement@veridianbio.com by EOD 2026-11-17 (attached: redwood_poc_agreement_v1.pdf). Please review and flag any non-standard terms.
